ruled.by: delegated: design (agent ruling under CONDUCTOR_AUTHORITY_DECIDE_NO_ASKING_MOM; delegation_policy.md: agents decide nearly everything; listed in the owner's daily digest)
ruled.owner_words: we really need to reskin all the old junk around the map that looks like tanks, trucks, cars, etc. to be more Star Wars wreckage focused ... Then decide on the roster we actually want spawning, and finally re-graphic and re-text them (2026-09-12)
ruled.how_to_read: kinds = what a scav reads in the junk (what it was, what it yields, what it risks), each bound to the defs that carry it. cut = defs taken OUT of vanilla's junk scatter (gen_junk_roster_cut.py makes Patches/AncientJunk_RosterCut.xml from this file). Yields are what the game really drops (killedLeavings, from Core's defs); risks are honest: none of this junk carries a hidden mechanic.

zeddos_yard.law: Decades of hauled discards, sorted by nobody: the Hutts' yard. Laid by the Zeddo's Yard template (src/RimUtinni/StructureInjectionsRUT/Templates/zeddos_yard.txt, generated by gen_zeddos_yard_plan.py); its tile is also on the Fall Line, so no vanilla ancient-junk scatter lands around it.

fall_line.law: Nothing here is old (design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/fall_line.md, FROZEN). The RUT_FallLine tile mutator's junkDensityFactor is 0 (FallLineArrivals setting noOldJunk, default on), so vanilla's ancient junk scatter does not run on Fall Line tiles; the wreckage there is what falls (RUT_FallLineWreckFall, RUT_WreckList_FallLine).

scatter.law: Every other surface map: vanilla's junk scatter GenSteps (AncientJunkClusters, ScarlandsJunkClusters, ScarlandsJunkPrefabs, ScatterRoadDebris) lay the reskinned wrecks below; the cut list takes out what has no Star Wars reading.

rakatan.law: Megastructure debris is mostly not junk at all: AncientMegastructure terrain and the injection templates. Nothing in this roster is labelled Rakatan; the old-age register is kept for the megastructure itself.

kinds.name: speeder hulks
kinds.was: civilian landspeeders, airspeeders, swoops and cargo speeders
kinds.yields: steel slag when broken up (2 for a hulk or frame, 6 for a full landspeeder)
kinds.risks: nothing; the coils and cells were pulled generations ago

kinds.name: military hulks
kinds.was: troop transports, armoured carriers, assault repulsorcraft, checkpoint barriers
kinds.yields: steel slag (6 from a transport or assault hulk, 2 from a carrier, 1 from a barrier)
kinds.risks: nothing live; the armour still stops blaster fire, so it is cover

kinds.name: walker and war-droid remains
kinds.was: combat walkers, spider droids, scout walkers, heavy blaster emplacements
kinds.risks: nothing; the weapons are fused and the power cores gone

kinds.name: starship wreckage
kinds.was: starfighter engines, sublight engine blocks, crashed shuttles and gunships
kinds.risks: nothing; the drive cores were pulled out

kinds.name: droid and drive scrap
kinds.was: toppled droid shells, power converters, vaporators, load lifters, drive wheels
kinds.yields: nothing worth hauling; it is the ground the yard is made of

kinds.name: ship chunks
kinds.was: torn-off sections of starships and mechanoid craft that came down not long ago
kinds.yields: steel and components when a ship chunk is deconstructed; slag chunks and slag pallets smelt down to steel

kinds.name: cargo: crates, containers, barrels
kinds.was: freight: shipping containers, crates of every make, fuel barrels and pallets

kinds.name: yard and works structure
kinds.was: cranes, fortified wall stubs, pipes, shelving, generators, lockers, lamps, turrets, a squatter's rotted bunk in a cave

kinds.name: barriers and wire
kinds.was: checkpoint lines: concrete fences, razor wire, blast barriers
kinds.risks: razor wire cuts whoever walks through it (vanilla)

kinds.name: dead old tech
kinds.was: beacons, cryptosleep caskets, pipeline sections, pollution machinery, a standpipe, a parts box, mechanoid slag
kinds.yields: what vanilla gives: a sealed casket may hold a sleeper, a parts box holds components, slag smelts to steel
kinds.risks: what vanilla gives: a casket's sleeper may be hostile; toxifier machinery pollutes

kinds.name: ruin walls and grave goods
kinds.was: the stone of buildings older than anyone's memory: walls, doors, columns, drapes, tables, urns, steles, a sarcophagus
kinds.yields: stone blocks or the stuff it was built of, when deconstructed
kinds.risks: a sarcophagus may hold what was buried with it (vanilla)
